entries.wording: Παραλαβή όλων των τεμαχίων της αποστολής στο κατάστημα παραλαβής: …
entries.note: All pieces received at the branch or hub named after the colon. A second hub can repeat it on the way.
Left the branch or hub the row names.
A piece, named by its number, arrived at a branch or hub. At a hub it is followed by " παραλαβής: " and the hub's name.
A piece arrived at the delivery station named after it.

entries.wording: Ανάθεση αποστολής για παράδοση σε διανομέα
entries.note: Given to a courier for delivery.
Followed by who took the parcel and the delivery's date and time, which the adapter drops.

entries.wording: ΑΠΟΣΤΟΛΗ ΕΝΗΜΕΡΩΣΗΣ ΠΑΡΑΛΗΠΤΗ ΣΤΟ ΤΗΛΕΦΩΝΟ: […] ΜΕ ΘΕΜΑ: […]
entries.note: A message to the recipient from the head office: the masked phone, then its subject, which can carry links to the parcel's delivery options or a survey. The adapter keeps only "ΑΠΟΣΤΟΛΗ ΕΝΗΜΕΡΩΣΗΣ ΠΑΡΑΛΗΠΤΗ".
The customer created the shipment; the reply appends the date and time. Seen in an archived reply of the tracker's earlier format.
Closed into a packing unit; the tracker of the time dated its first progress step with this event. Seen in an archived reply of the tracker's earlier format, which appends the date and time.
Arrived at the Athens (Acharnes) distribution centre, which the wording names. Seen in an archived reply of the tracker's earlier format, which appends the date and time.

entries.wording: Παραλαβή από σταθμό εξαγωγής.Κτχ Πάγκου-Διαδικασία χρέωσης
entries.note: Received from the outbound station and checked in at the counter for charging. Seen in an archived reply of the tracker's earlier format, which appends the date and time.
Forwarded through an outside partner's network for the last leg. Seen in an archived reply of the tracker's earlier format, which appends the date and time.
Delivered, with the delivery details recorded. Seen in an archived reply of the tracker's earlier format, which appends the date and time.
Title the tracker of the time gave its last progress step once the parcel was delivered. Seen in an archived reply of the tracker's earlier format.
Progress step label on the tracker page: shipment created.
Progress step label on the tracker page: received from the sender.
Progress step label on the tracker page: in transit.
Progress step label on the tracker page: arrived at the delivery station.
Progress step label on the tracker page: out for delivery.
Progress step label on the tracker page: delivered.
Progress step label on the tracker page, shown in place of the delivery step when the reply marks the parcel as going back to its sender: returned to the sender.
